events.continuity_hook: The return date and hotel requirement depend on whether an informal donor dinner is added Tuesday evening.
events.interaction_goal: Compare workable outbound and return itineraries while separating options for a Tuesday return from those requiring another night.
events.scenario_brief: Danielle needs a round-trip flight from Dallas to Chicago for a two-day youth-arts corporate partner summit in mid-September. She must arrive before a 1:00 p.m. planning meeting on Monday and can leave after the summit ends at 4:30 p.m. Tuesday; the organization has not yet confirmed whether she may stay a second night.

events.continuity_hook: This resolves the uncertain trip length from the initial search but leaves the flight and hotel combination to be selected.
events.interaction_goal: Refine the trip to a two-night stay, compare total costs, and identify a Wednesday flight that gets Danielle home before her virtual meeting.
events.scenario_brief: The donor dinner has been confirmed for Tuesday, so Danielle now needs to return Wednesday morning and add two hotel nights near the summit venue in the Loop. Her first meeting Wednesday back in Dallas is virtual at 11:30 a.m., making arrival time and a quiet place to join the call relevant.

events.continuity_hook: The family has not chosen between the two neighboring beach areas, and exact driving dates remain tied to the school calendar.
events.interaction_goal: Build a focused comparison of suitable coastal hotels in both areas, including mandatory fees and room occupancy details.
events.scenario_brief: Danielle, her spouse, and their 14-year-old daughter are considering a five-night fall-break stay on the Alabama Gulf Coast in October. They are deciding between Gulf Shores and Orange Beach and need one room that accommodates three people; they want to compare beachfront access, parking charges, and the total lodging cost before settling on an area.

events.continuity_hook: The destination and dates are settled, but transportation and the better-value hotel remain unresolved.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the door-to-door time and total trip cost of driving versus flying, then evaluate the two remaining hotels on an all-in basis.
events.scenario_brief: The school calendar confirms Saturday-to-Thursday dates, and the family has chosen Orange Beach. Danielle is now comparing driving the full distance from Dallas with flying to Pensacola and renting a car; the hotel shortlist has narrowed to two properties with materially different parking and breakfast costs.

events.continuity_hook: This follows the transportation decision and selected property; only occupancy terms, cancellation timing, and the final charge breakdown need verification.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the room terms and complete the lodging selection with a clear all-in price and cancellation deadline.
events.scenario_brief: The family has decided to drive and is ready to reserve the Orange Beach hotel that includes breakfast. Before booking, Danielle needs confirmation that the quoted room permits two adults and one teenager, that the cancellation deadline covers the period when a tropical-weather forecast would become useful, and that resort and parking charges are included in the total.

events.continuity_hook: A later session will need the confirmed venue and adjournment time before the return flight can be narrowed confidently.
events.interaction_goal: Identify feasible outbound flights and provisional Thursday returns while making clear which options depend on the pending meeting details.
events.scenario_brief: Danielle has been asked to attend a nonprofit board briefing in Washington, D.C., on a Thursday morning in early December. She expects to travel from Dallas Wednesday after a 2:00 p.m. office meeting and return Thursday evening, but the briefing venue and ending time have not yet been finalized.
